title: News - CoLab
markdown:
# News Room

CoLab is an engineering review platform that combines AI and human expertise to help hardware engineering teams identify, discuss, and resolve design issues. Founded in 2017, CoLab is where teams analyze engineering files, apply lessons from past projects to current designs, and make stronger design decisions.

Brand assets and photography are available in our [press kit](https://www.colabsoftware.com/news#kit)!
